draft.strengthQuote: Coach's son with outstanding work ethic on and off the field.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 124th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 13th of 22 at LB. He lasted until pick 220, well after his grade rank (124th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Matthew Adams. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2020) ranked 2nd in tackles among the 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers. 80 career games and 38 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: passer rating allowed 79.3 (84th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 off-ball linebacker who played: 92 combined tackles against a median of 66, above the norm.
